name: Azerbaijan
summary: South Caucasus nation bordering the Caspian Sea with historic fossil fuel heritage. Major natural gas supplier via the Southern Gas Corridor with ambitious Caspian offshore wind transition plans.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 3.92x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); Absheron peninsula experiences industrial dust and Caspian marine aerosol mixing.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; Caspian Sea water level dropping due to Volga basin evaporation anomalies.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming trend rate across Kura-Aras lowland stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.1% share of global fossil emissions; domestic natural gas power generation dominant.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below world average per capita rate; domestic gas grid covers 96% of households.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Greater Caucasus and Talysh mountain forests covering ~11,500 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydropower on the Kura and Tartar rivers supplies current clean power; 230 MW Garadagh solar operational.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 125 people/km²; urban population fraction is 56.6%.
